title: avengers standing-memory record (v1)
description: One admitted STANDING memory record (design §6). Standing memory is project-tier, injected into seats at BLIND_DIVERGE (identity + standing only). A record is admissible ONLY when provenance.source_type is one of the four Codex-class sources AND its kind is not an episodic kind (seat opinion / refuted position / single-session conclusion). Seat opinions, refuted positions, and single-session conclusions live in EPISODIC history and are NEVER standing memory. Validated by the bundled stdlib mini-validator (subset: type/required/properties/items/enum/const/additionalProperties/minItems/minimum). DATA/machine state (stdlib JSON), never executed. Home-tier only: standing.json lives at ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/avengers/members/<seat-id>/ and is NEVER repo-local (pre-poisoned-clone vector).
